title: Free Delivery on US$0.99 Spend on Bundle Deals, Choice & Brand+ Items @ AliExpress
body:
Deal: Free Delivery on US$0.99 Spend on Bundle Deals, Choice & Brand+ Items @ AliExpress

[chromium] Hmm bought some stuff a few hours ago and had to spend $15 AUD to get fee shipping
[Clear] Only applicable to anything within new bundle deals. Outside of that and regular rules apply.
[3dprintdeals] How do you get to the new bundle deals section?
[3dprintdeals] @Clear: Isn't that the regular bundles section, what are the new bundle deals you mentioned? Thanks
[Clear] @3dprintdeals: That's the new crappy bundle deals, aka bundledeals3 per the URL. Not the OG bundledeals2.
[sssx] @Clear: Tried that, it says free shipping over $15.
[Ezekiel2320] The app showed me $15 minimum on bundle deals but the mobile page shows 3+
[kaikor] Use Bundle Deal 2 instead, no price limit and just need to pick 3 items like before for free shipping
https://www.aliexpress.com/ssr/300000512/BundleDeals2
[fredk1000] I have not seen this for a few months, I have been looking at the other bundle deals since, I bought heaps of cheap stuff with this Bundle deals with 3+ items free shipping. I have been waiting and saving stuff in my cart and let it sit till I really need it and reach $15 to get free shipping. I see all the picks I added to the cart I have not seen for months. Thanks for the link.
[carrawa] Do you only leave 3 items in your cart at a time?
[fredk1000] Nah, the Bundle deals limit was full (20ish?), I have about 50 items in the normal cart. I maxxed out my wishlist yesterday of 1000 items.
[carrawa] @fredk1000: Lol, how do you check out, only in the bundles deals?
[Hiphopopotamus] Curiously the promo doesn't apply here.
My experience with Bundle Deal prices is that they drop significantly during sales, so best to wait if you can.
[fredk1000] The prices are volatile, it could go up or down whenever I found. Once I was looking almost purchase, the clock ticked over 12am prices went up in my cart, delayed the purchase.
[carrawa] Or they run out of stock while still adding things to your cart.
